name: Magmatic Stride
description: Stride on heavy molten steps that leave the ground glowing for a breath behind the user.

name: Clinker Fist
description: Hammer a fist hard with rough half-melted qi that grinds as it lands on the target.

name: Tephra Veil
description: Throw a veil of fine hot grit before the body that scours the hands of any striker.

name: Igneous Hook
description: Swing a hook with a forearm cooled to hard stone around a hot core.

name: Living Brand
description: Press a palm to the foe and let a mark of living magma burn into the flesh and spread.

name: Ropy Coil
description: Wind thick ropes of molten qi about the foe's limbs and let them cool into a hard hold.

name: Pyroclast Blow
description: Throw the whole body into one blow that bursts on contact in a spray of molten fragments.

name: Searing Mantle
description: Wrap the body in a mantle of live magma that blocks blows and scorches whoever strikes it.

name: Glowing Aura
description: Spread a thin glow of molten qi round the body and feel every heat that enters it.

name: Aura Scorch
description: Flare the living field outward so a wave of heat scorches all who stand close.

name: Basalt Plate
description: Harden a slab of the field into dark plate before the body to stop a straight blow.

name: Lava Glide
description: Skate over the ground on a film of molten qi that carries the body smoothly forward.

name: Heated Lance
description: Narrow the field into a hot lance of qi and thrust it through a single point of the guard.

name: Aura Smelt
description: Raise the field's heat until the foe's own qi runs thick and slow inside them.

name: Magmatic Tide
description: Surge a tide of molten qi across the ground that burns and shoves all in its path.

name: Molten Anchor
description: Sink an anchor of hot qi through the foe's feet into the ground and hold them to it.

name: Smelting Aura
description: Keep the field blazing so everything within it is slowly worn down and the foes' techniques weaken.

name: Pyroclastic Surge
description: Gather the field to a point then burst it outward as a roaring wall of hot grit and flame.

name: Azure Cinder
description: Flick a glowing cinder tinted blue from the fingertips at the face of the target.

name: Cinder Rush
description: Rush forward on a trail of sparking cinders that hides the body for a moment.

name: Soot Guard
description: Fling up a cloud of hot ash with the forearm that turns a blow aside in the haze.

name: Skyburn Palm
description: Strike with a palm that burns white hot at the centre and leaves a ring of scorch.

name: Cinder Storm
description: Whirl the arms to fling a storm of burning cinders over everything in front of the user.

name: Smolder Veil
description: Raise a wall of smoldering ash and heat that burns away the force of anything crossing it.

name: Scorching Lash
description: Whip a strand of white-hot qi across the foe's guard to burn it open and sting the face.

name: Cinderfall
description: Gather burning cinder qi overhead for several breaths and let it fall on foes in a slow glowing rain.

name: Azure Brand
description: Drive a blue-white fingertip of concentrated heat through the guard and burn a mark into the chest.

name: Forged Glide
description: Slide forward with the poise of a worked bar of hot metal drawn through a trough.

name: Smithing Palm
description: Bring a palm down flat and heavy as an anvil with hot qi behind it.

name: Tempering Guard
description: Temper the forearm by heat and chill in the instant of impact so it holds against the blow.

name: Hot Rivet
description: Flick a glowing rivet of qi that sticks and keeps burning where it lands.

name: Bellows Breath
description: Draw a deep working breath that fans the user's molten qi hotter and raises the strength of the next blows.

name: Slackened Link
description: Heat the joint of a foe's guard until it slackens and no longer holds the form.

name: Forged Edge
description: Draw the arm through a quick heating and cooling so it takes a keen edge for one stroke.

name: Welding Grip
description: Take hold of the foe and heat the grip until their limb fuses to the user's hand.

name: Ingot Press
description: Press down with both hands and force the foe's body to settle under the heavy heat.

name: Sky Forge
description: Gather the field into a roaring forge overhead and drop its glowing weight over a wide front.

name: Flowing Anvil
description: Bring a mass of molten qi down as a great anvil that flows round and then crushes the target.

name: Columnar Stance
description: Stand with the body set in tall tight columns of cooled stone that no shove can bend.

name: Hexagon Step
description: Step round a six-sided track of cooled stone laid by the foot to keep the foe at a distance.

name: Basalt Fist
description: Strike with a fist hardened to dark stone that bruises the guard that blocks it.

name: Hardened Flow
description: Let a flowing arm of hot stone cool at the instant of the block and shove the blow away.

name: Pillared Strike
description: Stamp down so a pillar of cooled basalt rises under the foe and strikes them upward.

name: Cooling Snare
description: Pour hot stone round the foe's legs and cool it fast so that they are held in a dark cast.

name: Sworn Basalt
description: Fix the body in sworn basalt that stands against any wind or blow and answers with a crushing shove.

name: Basalt Torrent
description: Pour a torrent of cooling basalt qi across the ground in front of the user and bury those it reaches.

name: Oath Crust
description: Swear the surface of the arms hard in one breath and take a blow on the crust.

name: Hardened Pace
description: Walk on a rind of cooled stone qi that does not give under the weight of the body.

name: Crust Breaker
description: Strike the crust of the foe's own guard where it is thinnest and break through.

name: Brittle Strike
description: Rap a cooled fist on a hardened guard so it cracks along every seam at once.

name: Fault Sense
description: Feel along the surface of a guard or wall for the faults where the crust is thin.

name: Crusted Skin
description: Thicken the outer skin of the body to a dark crust that turns the edge of a blow.

name: Crust Mantle
description: Hold a thick cooled mantle over the whole body with the heat sealed in behind it.

name: Cracking Blow
description: Crack the crust and let the hot qi beneath burst out through the opening into the foe.

name: Heat Beneath
description: Drive a thin spike of heat up through the ground and into the soles of the foe.

name: Crust Lock
description: Cool a skin of stone over the foe's arms and hold them close to the chest.

name: Crust Rupture
description: Let the held heat tear its crust at one moment and burst across the ground as a wide molten flood.

name: Oathbound Crust
description: Hold an oath-hard crust round the body that blocks blows and drains the force of foes who press it.
